description: COMPLETED. The HTTP edge, process wiring, end-to-end integration test, and build docs. internal/httpapi (stdlib net/http ServeMux with the one hard-coded GET /orders/{id} route that builds Ctx from the request and runs the interpreter, NO auth), cmd/engine (wire observ + secret provider + connect.Registry + decision.Engine + flow.Interpreter + httpapi; start the server; graceful shutdown on SIGINT/SIGTERM draining and closing pools + decision.Engine.Close()), the REAL-HTTP integration test (ephemeral postgres:16 + httptest REST stub, two ZEN-branching inputs — the real-package equivalent of the spike's AC-S3), and README/Makefile documenting CGO_ENABLED=1 + glibc base image. Depends on FEAT-001 (flow + observ) and FEAT-002 (connect + decision + config). Realizes the httpapi edge, Slice A §5 version pinning at the request boundary, Slice E cmd/engine lifecycle (AC-24), and AC-25 build posture.
steps: Read docs/.agents/tasks/context.json and this file FIRST. Then read docs/lld/slice-a-interpreter.md §5 (version pinning at the httpapi seam), docs/lld.md §3 (end-to-end flow), docs/phase0-spike-report.md (glibc image + CGO facts), and internal/spikeflow/interpreter_integration_test.go (the PROVEN ephemeral-postgres harness + httptest REST stub to copy).

internal/httpapi/server.go: build a *http.ServeMux registering GET /orders/{id} (Go 1.22 pattern-with-method routing). The handler: read path param id (r.PathValue("id")), resolve+PIN the FlowVersion once via config.Store.ActiveFlow(ctx, env, "GET", "/orders/{id}"), build flow.Ctx with Input seeded from the request (id, optional headers) and env on ctx, call Interpreter.Run(ctx, fv, c, deps), then encode c.Response as JSON with the Response node's status. Map classified errors to HTTP status: Validation->400, NotFound->404, Timeout->504, Upstream->502, Internal->500. Provide a constructor NewServer(store, interp, deps) returning an *http.Server or http.Handler so the integration test can exercise it.

cmd/engine/main.go: construct observ (slog), the env SecretProvider, connect.Registry from config.Store.Connections (register postgres + rest connectors), decision.Engine (JDMLoader adapter over config.Store.GetJDM), flow.Interpreter.New(), and the httpapi handler; load the config seed; start http.Server.ListenAndServe in a goroutine; block on signal.NotifyContext(SIGINT/SIGTERM); on signal call server.Shutdown(ctx) with a bounded timeout, then close registry pools and decision.Engine.Close() (-> zen Dispose). Log lifecycle transitions.

internal/httpapi/integration_test.go (//go:build integration && cgo): copy the startPostgres helper from internal/spikeflow/interpreter_integration_test.go (docker run -P postgres:16, docker inspect for the mapped port, poll until pgx connects). Create the orders table and seed id=1 {1500,'paid'} and id=2 {500,'paid'}. Start an in-process httptest.Server REST stub recording r.URL.Path hits and returning {ok:true}. Build a config.Store seeded with the thin-slice flow + order JDM, with the 'orders-pg' ConnectionDef Settings pointed at the ephemeral DSN and 'ship-rest' baseURL pointed at the stub URL. Build the real httpapi handler over the real connect.Registry + real decision.Engine. Issue GET /orders/1 and GET /orders/2 via httptest or the handler. Assert: /orders/1 => response JSON shipping=="expedited" AND exactly "/expedite" was hit; /orders/2 => shipping=="standard" AND exactly "/standard" was hit.

README.md: document the build/run (CGO_ENABLED=1 required for ZEN; a C toolchain must be present), the glibc-base-image requirement for the container (debian-slim/distroless, NOT Alpine/musl, per ADR-003/R9 and phase0-spike-report.md), the one route GET /orders/{id}, and how to run unit vs integration tests (Docker required for integration).
Makefile: targets `build` (CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./...), `test` (CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./...), `test-integration` (CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -tags 'integration cgo' ./internal/httpapi), and `vet`.
Run the full gate and fix any integration seams between FEAT-001/002/003.
acceptance_criteria: `CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./...` exits 0 (whole tree, including cmd/engine).
`CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./...` passes all unit tests.
`CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./internal/decision` exits 0 (stub still compiles after wiring).

`CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -tags 'integration cgo' ./internal/httpapi` passes BOTH branch cases: GET /orders/1 => shipping=expedited and only /expedite hit; GET /orders/2 => shipping=standard and only /standard hit, against a real ephemeral postgres:16 and a real httptest REST stub.
README documents CGO_ENABLED=1 + glibc base image; Makefile targets build/test/test-integration exist.
findings:
DONE. Full gate PASSES (go1.26.2, CGO on, Docker up):
1) `CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./...` exit 0 (whole tree incl. cmd/engine).
2) `CGO_ENABLED=1 go vet ./...` clean.
3) `CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./...` all pass (flow, connect, decision, config, httpapi unit, spikeflow, zenspike).
4) `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./internal/decision` exit 0 (the !cgo stub still compiles after wiring).
5) `CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -tags 'integration cgo' ./internal/httpapi` PASSES BOTH branch cases against a real ephemeral postgres:16 + a real in-process httptest REST stub + the real ZEN engine: GET /orders/1 => response shipping=="expedited" AND exactly [/expedite] hit; GET /orders/2 => shipping=="standard" AND exactly [/standard] hit. Also runnable via `make test-integration`. Makefile targets build/test/test-integration/vet all work.

=== WHAT WAS BUILT ===
- internal/httpapi/server.go: stdlib net/http ServeMux, the ONE route `GET /orders/{id}` (Go 1.22 method+pattern routing, r.PathValue("id")). NO auth. Resolves+PINS the FlowVersion once via store.ActiveFlow(ctx, "", "GET", "/orders/{id}"), builds flow.Ctx (input.id mapped from the path param), stamps env via decision.WithEnv, runs interp.Run(ctx, &fv.Tree, flow.Version{FlowID,Version}, c, deps) per the FEAT-001 import-cycle-break seam, encodes c.Response as JSON. Classified-error -> HTTP status: Validation->400, NotFound->404, Timeout->504, Upstream->502, Internal->500 (errors.Is against flow sentinels, never string-match). NewServer(addr,store,interp,deps)*http.Server and NewHandler(store,interp,deps)http.Handler (the test uses NewHandler).
- internal/httpapi/adapters.go: two PER-REQUEST edge adapters over the frozen seams (flow core untouched): (1) templatingRegistry/templatingClient resolves `{{path}}` placeholders in op.Payload against the live Ctx before Execute (whole-string placeholder preserves native type so `{{input.id}}` binds as an int SQL param; `input.` namespace maps to the Ctx.Input root; `order.`/`decision.` resolve from Ctx.Data), and normalizes the pg `[]map[string]any` result to the shapes GetPath descends (single row -> map so `order.amount` resolves; many -> []any; rest body passes through). (2) branchingEvaluator promotes a sole-value JDM output (`{shipping:"expedited|standard"}`) to out["branch"] so flow.conditionHandler selects the matching child (bridges the FEAT-002 SEED-vs-HANDLER caveat); leaves an existing branch/result untouched.
- cmd/engine/main.go: wires observ (slog JSON) + connect.NewEnvSecretProvider + connect.New(drivers.All(), seededDefs,...) + decision.New(jdmLoader over config.Store.GetJDM) + flow.New() + httpapi.NewServer; loads the seed; ListenAndServe in a goroutine; blocks on signal.NotifyContext(SIGINT/SIGTERM); graceful srv.Shutdown with a 15s bounded timeout, then deferred registry.Close() + engine.Close() (-> zen Dispose). Logs lifecycle transitions. Flags -addr, -seed.
- internal/httpapi/integration_test.go (//go:build integration && cgo): copies the PROVEN startPostgres helper + httptest REST stub shape from internal/spikeflow. Creates+seeds orders (id=1 {1500,'paid'}, id=2 {500,'paid'}), stub returns {shipping} derived from the hit path and records hits, overrides seeded orders-pg dsn + ship-rest baseURL, builds the real registry + real decision engine, drives the REAL httpapi handler, asserts both branches + exact single REST hit.
- internal/httpapi/server_test.go: unit tests (no Docker/CGO deps) for routing (matched/wrong-method/unknown-path), config-NotFound->404, statusForFlow mapping by errors.Is, coercePathParam, resolveTemplates (native-type + input. namespace + embedded substitution), normalizeResult, branchingEvaluator.
- README.md: documents the one route, CGO_ENABLED=1 requirement + the glibc-base-image rule (debian-slim/distroless, NOT Alpine/musl per ADR-003/phase0-spike-report), build/run, and unit-vs-integration test commands (Docker for integration).
- Makefile: build / test / test-integration / vet, all CGO_ENABLED=1.

=== INTEGRATION SEAMS BRIDGED (FEAT-001/002/003) — all at the httpapi EDGE, flow core unchanged ===
1) Template resolution: the seed carries `{{input.id}}`/`{{order}}` placeholders that nothing resolved; templatingClient resolves them against the request Ctx just before Execute.
2) HTTP path param typing: a path param is a string, but orders.id is INT and pgx rejects a text value against int4 under the extended protocol; the handler coerces a purely-numeric id to int (coercePathParam) and the whole-string template resolver preserves that int type.
3) pg result shape: the postgres driver returns []map[string]any but flow.GetPath only descends map[string]any/[]any; normalizeResult unwraps the single-row GET result to a map so `order.amount` projects.
4) decision->branch: the order JDM returns {shipping:...} (no branch/result), so a raw output fell to falseKey; branchingEvaluator promotes it to out["branch"] matching the condition's trueKey/falseKey.
No FROZEN interface was changed; no spike package was touched; stdlib net/http only.
